APEX DRAWDOWN ZERO V12  -  version 12.47
MetaTrader 5 Expert Advisor for XAUUSD (gold), H1 chart

QUICK INSTALL
1. In MetaTrader 5: File > Open Data Folder.
2. Copy  MQL5\Experts\ApexDrawdownZero_V12.ex5  into the  MQL5\Experts  folder there.
3. Copy the files in  MQL5\Presets  into the  MQL5\Presets  folder there.
4. Restart MetaTrader 5 (or right-click "Expert Advisors" in the Navigator > Refresh).
5. Open an XAUUSD H1 chart and drag the EA onto it. Tick "Allow Algo Trading".
6. Turn on the Algo Trading button in the toolbar. The dashboard should show MONITORING in green.

FTMO / PROP-FIRM CHALLENGE
In the Inputs tab press Load and choose ApexV12_FTMO_Mode_Phase1.set.
Then type your challenge size into "Challenge account size" (e.g. 100000).
For phase 2 load ApexV12_FTMO_Mode_Phase2.set.

Full instructions, settings and backtest results: ApexDrawdownZero_V12_User_Guide.pdf

Please demo-test before trading live. Trading involves substantial risk of loss.
Backtest results are hypothetical and do not guarantee future results.
